groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.715% and the 10Y at 5.081%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 9 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -5.52% over five sessions and -4.48% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.00% at about $109.86, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-43/100, 74% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is limited positive confirmation on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.081%, Nasdaq breadth is weak, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
